name: Responsibility requires a title
description: Saving a responsibility with an empty title is blocked.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Leave 'What needs doing?' empty and submit the form
Verify the form stays open and the empty 'What needs doing?' field is flagged as required
Close the form and open 'Care plan'
Verify no new untitled responsibility was added
